turns.question: What was the median, across the ten long-standing customers, of each customer's total non-cancelled order amount from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median or per-customer metric, and it defines no long-standing customers, so I cannot give that median. The closest metrics are Revenue (EUR), the sum of non-cancelled orders, and Average order value (EUR), which I can give for 17 August to 2 October 2026 across all customers.
